scope: Frank v0.1 promotion scheduling only; not an owner-fixed architecture or acceptance override
law: Waves prioritize scarce integration/promotion/Target-VPS capacity. They do not prohibit parallel research or implementation in later waves.
selection_rule: Prefer the earliest unresolved wave containing a P0/P1 risk, stale authority/provenance, recovery resurrection, or a dependency that prevents multiple downstream terminal receipts. Within a wave prefer promotion/reentry over spawning duplicate implementations.

waves.name: identity-runtime-authority spine
waves.why: These packages define the exact self.root identity, typed execution substrate, durable state, ingress/execution generation, effect authority and recovery semantics to which later cognitive receipts must bind.

waves.name: causal cognition spine
waves.why: These packages close the native Clay causal loop from state through selection/use to verified outcome, causal credit and re-entry.

waves.name: perception-agency-body
waves.why: These organs widen the already-authoritative loop into multimodal perception, proactive long-horizon behavior and typed external capability/body interaction.

waves.name: frozen data and final model
waves.why: Final training/evaluation should bind the real architecture and remains subject to explicit owner authorization.

waves.name: terminal end-to-end
waves.why: DOOMSDAY requires one exact target-VPS binary/model/state/API identity to pass all mandatory acceptance families together.

current_focus: F-V01-01: fresh-current self.root/binary trust and recovery-bound identity
F-V01-02: TypedIR -> type/effect -> evaluator -> compiler/lowering -> runtime/FFI on real Frank components
F-V01-08: full production token/response/session lifecycle acceptance
F-V01-09: exact V16 effect capability, non-bypassable routing, real provider unknown-outcome reconciliation, canonical verified-outcome -> reentry -> DONE
